name: $100 Allocation Test
deliverable: Capital-constrained prioritization surfacing true value trade-offs

steps.text: Give every person one hundred dollars of play budget and require the whole amount to be spent.
State that allocations are whole dollars across the slate, so every choice costs another option.
Have people invest silently and independently, then hand in their sheets before any discussion.
Total the sheets and mark broad consensus assets above a quarter of the money, plus single-bidder bets.
Discuss the outliers and the zeros; a shared zero shows what the group will not fund.

failure: Peanut-buttering: the budget is split evenly across every item, so no trade-off is made and nothing is ranked.
intervention: Reject a flat allocation and require one zero plus at least forty dollars on a single item; ask what that choice reveals.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in participatory budgeting; no single documented originator.
